narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.72 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.01430-0.01473 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.01484; the first objective pays 2.02R at 0.01415.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.01484 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 20/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $1.3M -3.3% below · short liq $82k +3.3% above
